title: The ML-SUPERB 2.0 Challenge: Towards Inclusive ASR Benchmarking for All Language Varieties

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) Character Error Rate (CER) and Language Identification (LID) accuracy across 149 diverse languages. The evaluation specifically measures 'Language Robustness' by calculating the standard deviation of CER across all languages and the average CER of the model's 15 worst-performing languages.

Measuring ASR Character Error Rate (CER) and Language Identification (LID) accuracy on a newly curated test suite of 93 distinct accents and dialects to evaluate model robustness and fairness on non-standard speech varieties.
